title: send input
description: §6.4 — send(coordinates, payload, returnReceipt = false, window?) -> Postmark | AttemptedDeliverySlip.

coordinates.description: Must carry a resolution proof, or SEND_UNRESOLVED (§6.4).

payload.description: §6.4: 'payload is bytes'. Carried base64 because a tool input is JSON. One AEAD operation covers the whole of it (§7.3); what does not fit in an envelope is referenced from inside one (§7.5).

returnReceipt.description: §7.7. When true, postage includes the receipt fee and chunk 0's header requests it.

window.description: Seconds to wait at first contact for the recipient to answer the doorbell. When it closes, send returns an AttemptedDeliverySlip and stops - a result, not a failure (F-6, P-14).
